overview.short: Ramrekha Mandir is a Hindu temple in Basti district, Uttar Pradesh, India, dedicated to Rama and Sita.
overview.description: Ramrekha Mandir is a Hindu temple in Basti district, Uttar Pradesh, India, dedicated to Rama and Sita. The pilgrims' first stop of 84 kosi parikrama of Ayodhya is at Ramrekha Temple in Basti. The temple is near Amorha (also known as Amorha Khas) in Basti district in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. Amorha Khas is a town and a Gram panchayat in Basti district.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Ramrekha Mandir?
faq.a: The best time to visit Ramrekha Mandir is Oct – Mar. Summers are 25–42°C and winters are 7–24°C.

faq.q: How do I reach Ramrekha Mandir?
faq.a: The nearest airport is Ramrekha Mandir / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Gorakhpur Junction (98 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Ramrekha Mandir?
faq.a: 2 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Ramrekha Mandir at a relaxed pace.

faq.q: How much does a hotel cost in Ramrekha Mandir?
faq.a: Stays in Ramrekha Mandir start from ₹900 per night, with options across 4 price categories.

faq.a: The top attractions are Shriram Kuti, Amorha, Chhawani, Harraiya.
